reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraphs, so no unwarranted counterparty right is introduced.

The cited paragraphs support the rationale: p0014 is a one-way invoicing/supporting-detail mechanic imposing obligations on Contractor, not an examination right over Company's records, usage or systems; p0007 runs in our favour by subjecting Contractor personnel to Company access and security policies.

AUDIT is a protective cap on a counterparty right, so its complete absence is strictly better than the preferred position; 'compliant' rather than 'missing' is the correct classification and no new language should be inserted.

The failed 'audit frequency limited' check is correctly treated as heuristic noise — no frequency cap can be found because there is no audit right to cap, not because audits are unlimited or unannounced.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the residual watch item that a future Statement of Work introducing a verification right should carry the preferred limits.
